title: Flat tensor comparison from a flat multiplication map
statement:
Let $R,S,T,U$ be commutative rings in one fixed universe, with compatible ring maps $R\to S\to T$ and $R\to S\to U$. Tensor products are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with multiplication $(x\otimes y)(x'\otimes y')=xx'\otimes yy'$ and unit $1\otimes1$. If the multiplication homomorphism $S\otimes_R S\to S$, $s\otimes s'\mapsto ss'$, is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then the canonical homomorphism
$$T\otimes_R U\longrightarrow T\otimes_S U,\qquad t\otimes u\longmapsto t\otimes u$$
is flat.
